content: Open Application: ICEYE Global Manufacturing Operations (GMO) Role highlights - Location: Across all ICEYE hubs - Department: Global Manufacturing Operations (GMO) - Employment type: Permanent - Workplace model: Office / Hybrid, depending on the role and site - Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) Why this application matters This is not a live vacancy. It is how we meet talented people before the right role exists. We open new roles in GMO all the time, and strong candidates are rarely on the market for long. Apply once, tell us what you do best and what you want next, and when a role matches your profile, we will contact you. Applying does not guarantee contact. We review applications monthly. Please submit your CV or resume in English, as we cannot review applications in other languages. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Application Process 1. Upload your CV or resume in English and fill in a short form 2. You receive an automatic confirmation 3. We contact you when a matching role opens and move you into that role’s process 4. If there is no match yet, your profile stays in our talent pool for 12 months, as long as you gave permission Working at ICEYE At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. YOUR DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES - Own day-to-day customs clearance across the EU: release for circulation, outward/inward processing, transit (T1, T2, TIR), customs warehousing, bonded storage and temporary admission. - Maintain HS/Taric classification and customs valuation for both supplier-sourced and in-house manufactured goods. - Spot risks in international shipments early and resolve them before they reach destinations. - Understand and apply Incoterms with confidence, allocating cost, risk and responsibility correctly across every lane. - Prepare for and take part in customs audits, and help strengthen the internal audit and control programme. - Run Binding Tariff Information (BTI) applications regularly and keep the resulting rulings current. - Write clear SOPs that colleagues can follow without you having to explain them. - Pursue free trade agreement benefits (preferential origin, EUR.1, statements on origin, REX registration) and maintain the supplier declaration chain. - Track and report the impact of your work: duty avoided, duty recovered and landed cost reduced. - Contribute to Freight Forwarding strategy across road, air and sea, flagging where routing, mode or documentation choices affect customs treatment or cost. - Recognise dangerous goods shipments (IATA DGR, ADR, IMDG) and check the required documentation. - Support material flow between ICEYE's Espoo site and our sites worldwide, reconciling physical goods against ERP, WMS and TMS records. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR (MUST HAVES): - A track record of reducing duty and landed cost through preferential origin, free trade agreements, relief or suspension regimes, or classification and valuation work, with results you can point to. - Working knowledge of rules of origin and the origin documentation regime, including supplier declarations. - Solid understanding of freight forwarding across road, air and sea, including how transport is planned in each mode. - Professional-level Finnish in addition to English. - Curiosity, eagerness to learn more and take full ownership over your scope of

SUPO, where required) Why this role matters The Quality Management System (QMS) Specialist/engineer is responsible for implementation of the ICEYEs Quality Management System in our Valencia production unit to ensure consistent delivery of products and services that meet customer, regulatory, and industry standards. In this role you will partner closely with production, supply chain, Health and safety teams to ensure that our processes are aligned with business goals and embedded into daily practices. This role will report to the Global Quality Management System (QMS) manager and operate as a standalone position within the Spain facility. Who We Are ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits. As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience. ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation. ICEYE operates at the intersection of commercial space technology and sovereign defence, so our compliance posture (ISO 27001, NIS2, NIST, and national frameworks) has to be credible to customers who include governments and defence agencies. You'll be the person who keeps that posture accurate, current and audit-ready, maps client and national requirements to internal ICEYE requirements, as a senior individual contributor. This role will be working closely with all the ICEYE Security team domains, ICEYE IT, ICEYE product management and the Program Management Office, Engineering and Sales. ROLE HIGHLIGHTS: - Quality Control Technician - Mechanical - Location: Greece - Department: Stock Management - Reports to: Manager, Stock Management - Employment type: Permanent - Workplace model: Office - Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required) WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS: This role is responsible for performing, visual, and mechanical inspections and quality checks to ensure that all hardware used in ICEYE satellite missions meets defined quality standards throughout the product lifecycle. The Quality Control Technician supports the implementation of inspection plans by conducting inspections during receiving, ensuring that all components and subsystems conform to requirements prior to shipment. The role is embedded within the production and AIT environment, working closely with Production, AIT Engineering, Mission Assurance, and Supply Chain teams to identify defects early, prevent quality escapes, and maintain compliance with space-grade standards.
